verdict.rationale: Rippling publishes developer documentation, a sandbox environment, and APIs/SDKs for building custom integrations (rippling-docs-8, rippling-docs-43, rippling-docs-47), backed by a live llms.txt developer doc endpoint and an open-source CLI (rippling-probe-1, rippling-probe-2, rippling-gh-1) confirming a real, accessible public API surface. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer reports of hands-on API usage, and more detail on API scope/versioning/rate limits beyond marketing pages.
